items.title: Architectural Design Review
items.front: Checking architectural drawings against municipal requirements and the building code.
items.back: A detailed review of architectural plans and facades, ensuring compliance with municipal and civil defense requirements before licensing.

items.title: Structural Design Review
items.front: Verifying structural safety, loads, and engineering calculations.
items.back: Auditing structural calculations and drawings to confirm load-bearing capacity in line with the Saudi Structural Design Code.

items.title: Electrical Systems Review
items.front: Auditing electrical designs against SBC 401 and safety standards.
items.back: Reviewing electrical loads, panels, and feeders to ensure efficiency and safety in line with SBC 401.

items.title: HVAC Systems Review
items.front: Evaluating ventilation and HVAC systems for efficiency and technical fit.
items.back: Reviewing HVAC loads and ventilation, confirming the chosen systems are efficient and compatible with the architectural design.

items.title: Plumbing & Drainage
items.front: Reviewing water and drainage networks against health requirements.
items.back: Inspecting water supply and sanitary drainage networks to confirm compliance with approved health and environmental requirements.

items.title: Fire Protection & Safety
items.front: Checking alarm and suppression systems and general evacuation routes.
items.back: Reviewing early warning and suppression systems and evacuation routes to confirm compliance with civil defense requirements.

items.title: Energy Efficiency & Thermal Insulation
items.front: Assessing thermal insulation compliance and energy efficiency requirements.
items.back: Evaluating insulation materials and their compliance with energy efficiency requirements under Saudi energy-saving building standards.

items.title: General Code Compliance
items.front: A comprehensive report combining results from every discipline into one compliance document.
items.back: Consolidating review results from every discipline into a unified report showing compliance points and notes before execution begins.

items.q: How long does it take to issue the technical review report?
items.a: It depends on the project size and service type requested, averaging between 7 and 14 business days from receiving the complete drawings.

items.q: Is your report accepted by municipal authorities?
items.a: Yes, the report is issued in an official, documented format that can be used as part of the project file before the relevant authorities.

items.q: Do you offer a re-evaluation service after revisions?
items.a: Yes, once we receive the revised drawings we re-evaluate only the items previously flagged.

items.q: Is the service available to engineering firms on an ongoing basis?
items.a: We offer ongoing review partnerships for engineering firms with preferential pricing based on annual collaboration volume.
